title: Coconut vegetable noodle soup
toddlerSplit: Ladle the toddlers' noodles and vegetables out before the curry paste goes in — theirs is plain coconut broth. Snip the noodles short and serve barely warm.
steps: Nothing fresh needed — this is the end-of-week recipe that runs on the cupboard and freezer.
Simmer the coconut milk with 400ml water and a stock cube.
Add frozen peas, spinach and drained sweetcorn, plus grated carrot if any are left. 5 minutes.
Add the rice noodles, 4 minutes until soft.
Ladle out the toddlers' bowls now.
Stir curry paste into the remaining pan, squeeze in lime, serve hot.
